Title: The Sealed Letter

Steps.Description: On the Gravenmarsh Causeway, Kesh of Reed-End presses a sealed letter and a silver signet into the player's hand. 'Drest. Eyes only. Not Varn. Especially not Varn.'
AvailableChoices: accept: Take the letter and swear by the signet.
Steps.ChosenChoiceText: Take the letter and swear by the signet.

Steps.Description: At Gravenhold's outer gate, Lieutenant Varn intercepts. 'The Commander's schedule is tight. I'll take that.' His hand is already out.
AvailableChoices: hand-over: Hand the letter to Varn.

Steps.Description: Varn does not forget. To reach Drest unaccompanied, the player must pick a method.
AvailableChoices: servants-stair: Take the servants' stair (Thornwood-sympathetic scullery mage).
rider-privilege: Invoke the Rider's once-per-arc commission privilege.

Steps.Description: In Drest's private chamber the seal cracks. Drest reads. He goes very still. 'Orla saw a glyph. On a skeleton that should not have had bones.' He needs Brother Velm of Eastmile — fast.
AvailableChoices: accept-velm: Accept the ride to Eastmile.

Steps.Description: East road. Varn (if flagged) has already dispatched two assumed-deniable footmen to a forest choke-point. Velm is at the chapel; which of him survives depends on the player.
AvailableChoices: fight-through-fast: Ride fast, fight the ambush, reach Velm inside three days.
detour-safe-slow: Detour via the Holt (safe but slow — five+ days).
fail-ambush: Take the ambush badly. Velm not retrieved.
Steps.ChosenChoiceText: Ride fast, fight the ambush, reach Velm inside three days.

Steps.Description: Velm reads the glyph at Gravenhold. He breaks down. 'This is a naming. A *funerary* naming. Something in that expedition was already dead, and someone had already un-killed it.' Drest promotes the player's access.
The Ardweld Remnant precursor is live. Drest trusts the player with the Lost Expedition's real worth. Player reputation with Gravenguard pushed toward Trusted.
